name: @polaris/genoffice-docs
description: GenOffice's docs editor, its renderer half. Ported from GenOffice (Apache-2.0) - see NOTICE. Not wired to a route: the bridge it talks to is an Electron channel, and Polaris' equivalent is server actions.

scripts.build: tsup src/renderer/App.tsx src/renderer/components/icons.tsx --format esm --dts --clean --external react --external react-dom && node ../../scripts/scope-editor-styles.mjs genoffice-docs --assets=/office-fonts @ui/tokens.css @ui/screentip.css @ui/color-picker.css @ui/dropdown.css @ui/ribbon-collapse.css @ui/markdown.css src/renderer/styles.css src/renderer/fonts/fonts.css
